limitations: Finite generalized residual is checked by unchanged source/NPZ/receipt evidence; full H and M matrices were not persisted for a separate residual recomputation.
The independent reductions certify returned finite-basis output consistency, not actual PDE discretization error or continuum isolation.
The ordinal rank-five target is not an established finite-R atomic-channel correlation.
Known supplied guard spacing is not a lower bound on gaps to omitted |m|>=2 sectors, unreturned roots or continuum.
Outer-layer concentration is inside the fixed box and gives no outside-box tail bound.
One serial NumPy versus two-rank native wall-time comparison confounds backend and parallelism; NCP64 scaling remains unmeasured.
